blocks.text: Today’s headlines: Baste Duterte, Sara Duterte, School safety
Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Baste Duterte ‘confession’ on Gencorp deals could be ‘smoking gun’ – prosecution

blocks.text: The prosecution says Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte‘s statement downplaying his city government’s contracts with Gencorp only strengthens the need for him to take the witness stand.

items: After Rappler report, more Gencorp contracts with Davao City Hall confirmed

blocks.text: The government’s electronic procurement system confirms Gencorp, a company linked to Vice President Sara Duterte, won more contracts than initially reported by Rappler.

items: Senate approves school safety bill after fatal shootings

blocks.text: The Senate approves a bill that institutionalizes a comprehensive school safety framework.

items: DICT retracts claim House called Meta CEO Zuckerberg to hearing

blocks.text: The Department of Information and Communications Technology retracts its claim saying the House of Representatives called Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg to a hearing on social media safety.

items: CNN, MS NOW, Politico suing Trump over White House ban

blocks.text: News organizations CNN, MS NOW, and Politico are suing US President Donald Trump and other members of his administration. – Rappler.com
